name: RC-B10-0071/2026 – After § 1 – Am 16
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text: 1g. Reaffirms that the choice of its political leadership and institutional arrangements belongs solely to the Iranian people; underlines that it is not for the EU to endorse, promote or favour any particular opposition figure or candidate, nor to attempt to shape Iran’s political future from abroad;
